title: Two's a Crowd: Human and AI-Based Copresence for Developers with ADHD
abstract: arXiv:2609.21254v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Effective collaboration and communication are vital to developer productivity and well-being, yet remain constrained by human factors such as attention, intrinsic motivation, and interpersonal accountability. These constraints are particularly vital for developers identifying with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), who navigate persistent environmental barriers in modern hybrid workplace settings. While developers with ADHD frequently rely on collaborative copresence practices (such as body doubling or pair programming) to support executive function, the recent emergence of agentic AI coding assistants has begun reshaping these collaborative dynamics. translated_title: 两人亦是“众”：ADHD开发者的人际与AI共同在场
translated_abstract: 有效的协作与沟通对开发者的生产力和福祉至关重要，但仍然受到注意力、内在动机和人际问责等人为因素的制约。这些制约对自我认同为注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的开发者尤为重要，他们在现代混合办公环境中长期面临各种环境障碍。虽然ADHD开发者常常依赖协作性的共同在场实践（如“陪伴工作”（body doubling）或结对编程）来支持执行功能，但近来代理型AI编程助手的兴起已开始重塑这些协作动态。为了探究ADHD开发者如何参与人际与AI共同在场实践，我们对14名患有ADHD的软件工程师进行了半结构化访谈。我们的研究结果表明，虽然传统的人与人共同在场能够提供关键的社会支持与上手引导（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 本研究通过对14名ADHD软件工程师的半结构化访谈，首次系统考察了他们如何在人际共同在场实践（如body doubling、结对编程）与新兴代理型AI编程助手之间开展协作，揭示了AI助手正在重塑ADHD开发者的协作动态与执行功能支持方式。
en_tdlr: Through semi-structured interviews with 14 software engineers with ADHD, this study systematically examines how they engage in both human-based copresence practices (e.g., body doubling, pair programming) and emerging agentic AI coding assistants, revealing how AI is reshaping collaborative dynamics and executive function support for developers with ADHD.
